picker.title: Register
picker.description: Choose a register to start selling. Each register shows whether its drawer is open.
picker.emptyManage: Add a register in Register settings, with its cash account and legal entity, to start selling.
picker.emptyAsk: Ask an administrator to set up a register for your legal entity.

scan.label: Scan or search items
scan.placeholder: Scan a barcode or type an item code or name
scan.noQuickKeys: No quick keys are set up for this register. Scan or search to add items.

cart.empty: Scan an item to start the sale.
cart.invalidQuantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero, with up to four decimal places.
cart.priceHelp: Enter the unit price for this line, or leave it blank to use the item's selling price.
cart.invalidPrice: Enter a price with up to four decimal places.
cart.discountHelp: Enter a percentage such as 10% or an amount such as 2.50. Leave it blank to remove the discount.
cart.invalidDiscount: Enter a percentage such as 10% or an amount such as 2.50.

held.title: Held sales
held.label: Name for the held sale
held.empty: No sales are on hold at this register.
held.summaryBy: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} · held by {by}
held.finishCurrent: Finish or clear the current sale before resuming a held sale.

refund.title: Refund
refund.overLimit: A line asks to refund more than remains unrefunded on the receipt.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.emailPlaceholder: Email address (blank uses the customer's email)

session.openHelp: Count the float in the drawer. Sales can start once the drawer is open.
session.closedNoPermission: The drawer is closed. Ask a user who can open the drawer to count the float and open it.
session.closeHelp: Count everything in the drawer. The count is blind: the expected amount and any over or short appear after the count is recorded.

count.invalid: Enter whole counts for each denomination, or a valid cash amount.

history.description: Drawer sessions for every register in your legal entities. Open a session for its X report, or its Z report once closed.
history.empty: No register sessions match these filters.

errors.registerLoad: The register could not be loaded.
errors.quote: The sale could not be priced.
errors.search: The search could not be completed.
errors.sale: The sale could not be completed.
errors.retrySafe: Try again: the sale will not be recorded twice.
errors.hold: The held sale could not be saved or loaded.
errors.openSession: The drawer could not be opened.
errors.report: The session report could not be loaded.
errors.movement: The cash movement could not be recorded.
errors.close: The drawer could not be closed.
errors.receiptLoad: The receipt could not be loaded.
errors.refund: The refund could not be completed.
errors.print: The receipt could not be printed.
errors.email: The receipt could not be emailed.
